```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## 1. Path Configuration

```{r paths}
input_file <- "C:/Users/10935/Documents/Proyecto_Adenocarcinoma_RNAseq/06_differential_expression/DEGs_significant.csv"
output_dir <- "C:/Users/10935/Documents/Proyecto_Adenocarcinoma_RNAseq/08_figures_tables"
```

## 2. Load Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

## 3. Load Data

```{r load-data}
degs <- read.csv(input_file)

cat("Total DEGs loaded:", nrow(degs))
```

## 4. Map Ensembl IDs to Gene Symbols

```{r map-symbols}
# Strip version suffix from Ensembl IDs (e.g. ENSG00000001.12 -> ENSG00000001)
degs$ensembl_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", degs$gene_id)

# Map to gene symbols using org.Hs.eg.db
symbols <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                  keys     = degs$ensembl_clean,
                  column   = "SYMBOL",
                  keytype  = "ENSEMBL",
                  multiVals = "first")

# Add symbols to data frame
degs$symbol <- symbols[degs$ensembl_clean]

# Mapping summary
mapped <- sum(!is.na(degs$symbol))
cat("Successfully mapped:", mapped, "of", nrow(degs),
    "(", round(mapped / nrow(degs) * 100, 1), "%)")
```

## 5. Top Genes for Results Section

### Top 10 upregulated in tumor

```{r top-upregulated}
top_up <- degs %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol)) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj, baseMean) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FoldChange = round(log2FoldChange, 3),
    padj           = formatC(padj, format = "e", digits = 2),
    baseMean       = round(baseMean, 2)
  )

top_up %>%
  kable(caption = "Top 10 genes upregulated in tumor") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

### Top 10 downregulated in tumor

```{r top-downregulated}
top_down <- degs %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol)) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj, baseMean) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FoldChange = round(log2FoldChange, 3),
    padj           = formatC(padj, format = "e", digits = 2),
    baseMean       = round(baseMean, 2)
  )

top_down %>%
  kable(caption = "Top 10 genes downregulated in tumor") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

## 6. Prepare Supplementary Tables

```{r supplementary-tables}
# Top 200 DEGs by absolute log2FC magnitude
supp_top200 <- degs %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  head(200) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj, baseMean) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FoldChange = round(log2FoldChange, 3),
    padj           = formatC(padj, format = "e", digits = 2),
    baseMean       = round(baseMean, 2),
    regulation     = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))

# Full DEG table with symbols
supp_complete <- degs %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, gene_id, log2FoldChange, padj, baseMean) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FoldChange = round(log2FoldChange, 3),
    padj           = formatC(padj, format = "e", digits = 2),
    baseMean       = round(baseMean, 2),
    regulation     = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))
```

## 7. Export Tables

```{r export}
# Top 200 supplementary table
write.csv(supp_top200,
          file.path(output_dir, "Anexo_Top200_DEGs.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Full table with symbols
write.csv(supp_complete,
          file.path(output_dir, "DEGs_con_simbolos_completo.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Files exported to:", output_dir, "\n")
cat("  - Anexo_Top200_DEGs.csv\n")
cat("  - DEGs_con_simbolos_completo.csv\n")
```

## 8. Results Section Text

```{r results-text, results='asis'}
top3_up_symbols <- top_up$symbol[1:3]
top3_up_fc      <- top_up$log2FoldChange[1:3]
top2_down_symbols <- top_down$symbol[1:2]
top2_down_fc      <- top_down$log2FoldChange[1:2]

cat("---\n\n")
cat("**Copy to Results section:**\n\n")
cat("> Among the genes with the highest upregulation in tumor tissue were **",
    top3_up_symbols[1], "** (log2FC = ", top3_up_fc[1], "), **",
    top3_up_symbols[2], "** (log2FC = ", top3_up_fc[2], "), and **",
    top3_up_symbols[3], "** (log2FC = ", top3_up_fc[3], "). ",
    "The most strongly downregulated genes included **",
    top2_down_symbols[1], "** (log2FC = ", top2_down_fc[1], ") and **",
    top2_down_symbols[2], "** (log2FC = ", top2_down_fc[2], "). ",
    "The complete DEG list with gene symbols is provided in Supplementary Table X.",
    sep = "")
```
